lines.differs: Better for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: billed monthly on time-and-materials hourly rates rather than fixed fees tied to milestone delivery.
Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: payment is due within 30 days instead of 45 days, and billed monthly on time-and-materials.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: lacks late payment interest of 1% per month on overdue invoices.
